{{Top|leg}}
A '''wind catamaran''' was a type of small [[wind rider]] employed by the [[Sevari]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sevarcos II]]. [[Spice lord|Spice Lord]] [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Trevael]]'s personal wind ship was a sleek wind catamaran colored [[Color/Legends|black]] and named after the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] prevalent in her lands &mdash; the ''[[Carsunum Chariot]]''.
